info.title: CNGOKZAPI
info.description:
API of the CNGOKZAPI platform for the CS:GO / CS2 KZ community.

All endpoints are versioned under `/api/v1` (except health probes and documentation). Successful responses use the `{ success, data, message }` envelope, failures use `{ success, error, message }` with a proper HTTP status code.

get.description: Version, environment, start time and uptime of the running API instance.
Real, per-request connectivity status of PostgreSQL and Redis together with uptime information.
Returns `ok` when the process can serve HTTP requests. Dependencies are not checked, use `/health/ready` for that.
Returns `alive` while the process is running. Intended for orchestrator liveness probes.
Probes PostgreSQL and Redis. Responds 503 with sanitized check details when any dependency is unavailable.

items.description:
A current world record with optional historical improvement fields.

`previous_time_ns` / `improvement_ns` are always `null` in phase 4 because the
schema does not store WR transition history.

last_record_at.description: Upload time of the best record (not the run duration).

time_diff_ns.description: Positive = player A faster, negative = player B faster.

DependencyStatusDto.description: Sanitized state of a single dependency.

detail.description: Stable reason when the dependency is down (`timeout`, `connection_failed`, ...).

ErrorCode.description:
Stable, machine readable error codes. Clients should branch on these instead
of parsing `message`.
